definitions.gloss: moderation; the golden mean; the middle way
definitions.explanation: The principle of avoiding extremes and maintaining balance. Also the title of one of the Four Books of Confucianism.

⟦{何事|なにごと}→何事：11463_nanigoto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{中庸|ちゅうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
{中庸|ちゅうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ず、⟦{極端|きょくたん}→極端：13161_kyokutan⟧な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: We should not forget the spirit of moderation and avoid extreme judgments.

notes:
A concept rooted in Confucian philosophy, referring to the ideal of balance and avoiding extremes. {中庸|ちゅうよう} is also the title of one of the {四書|ししょ} (Four Books) of Confucianism, known in English as "The Doctrine of the Mean."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中庸|ちゅうよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain moderation
- {中庸|ちゅうよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to find the middle ground
- {中庸|ちゅうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: the spirit of moderation
- {中庸|ちゅうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{徳|とく}→徳：23014_toku⟧: the virtue of moderation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{節度|せつど}→節度：13769_setsudo⟧: moderation, restraint — focuses on self-control in behavior
- ⟦{均衡|きんこう}→均衡：05217_kinkou⟧: equilibrium, balance — more technical, about balanced states

{中庸|ちゅうよう} carries philosophical weight, suggesting a principled avoidance of extremes rather than simple moderation.
